code: retval = UA_decodeBinary(msg, &offset, request, requestType, server->config.customDataTypesSize, server->config.customDataTypes);
note: The candidate's binary MSG chunks are decoded into service request structures, including AddNodesRequest messages that control node identifiers, parent references, and type definitions.
The decoded AddNodesItem selects and allocates a concrete UA_Node subtype in the nodestore.
The input-controlled NodeId is copied into the node and is the identity used when the inserted node is later removed.
Ownership of the populated node is transferred to the nodestore, but the caller retains the raw node pointer.

code: retval = addParentAndTypeRef(server, session, node, parentNodeId, referenceTypeId, &item->typeDefinition.nodeId);
note: A raw nodestore-owned node pointer is passed to code that can delete that same node; the missing safety condition is that node must still be live after this call before further pointer use.
On an invalid AddNodes parent or type relation, the helper deletes the inserted node through its NodeId while the caller still holds node.
The stale node pointer is used after the helper may already have deleted it, driving invalid node-member cleanup that reaches UA_Node_deleteMembers and NodeId_deleteMembers.
